definitions.explanation: An extremely brief period of time.
Used adverbially to describe something happening very briefly.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
{一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}した→離す：noentry⟧⟦{隙|すき}→隙：10999_suki_gap⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: In the instant I looked away.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The scenery changed in an instant.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: For an instant, I didn't understand what happened.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I hesitated for a moment, but decided right away.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{人込|ひとご}み→人込み：03709_hitogomi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消|き}えた→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: I caught a glimpse of his face for an instant, but he quickly disappeared into the crowd.

notes:
{一瞬|いっしゅん} refers to a very brief moment.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}の + noun (a momentary ~)
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で (in an instant)
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}にして (in a flash)
- ほんの{一瞬|いっしゅん} (just a moment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {瞬間|しゅんかん}: moment, instant
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}: instant (emphasizes brevity)
- {一刻|いっこく}: a moment (literary)
